body.condition: For each \(\ell\in\{-,+\}\) and every \(x\) on side \(\ell\) of \(c_P\), \[|\operatorname{Cov}_P(Y,D\mid X=x,\ell)|\le(1-v)\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}_P(Y\mid X=x,\ell)\operatorname{Var}_P(D\mid X=x,\ell)}.\] If \(\operatorname{Var}_P(D\mid X=x,\ell)=0\), then the covariance is zero and the display is interpreted as \(0\le0\), without forming a correlation coefficient.

standard.name: Adapted/sufficient specialization, cf. NoackRothe2024 (observable correlation separation)
